attributes.title: LIMITLESS 2027 BrownGirl RDH Conference
attributes.summary:
BrownGirl RDH moves its conference to Caesars Palace in Las Vegas for 2027, under the name LIMITLESS. It opens with an evening reception on Thursday, May 20, followed by courses, talks and lunch on Friday, with the afternoon left free, and a Saturday session that ends by 2 p.m. on May 22. The organizer plans 10 CE hours in total, five each day, and says final course details are still to come.

The focus this time is on careers more than clinical technique: pay and production, jobs outside the operatory, independent and mobile hygiene, and practice or DSO leadership. Hygienists are the core audience, though assistants, dentists, students and educators are also invited.

The early rate is $349 through January 31, 2027, or until 50 tickets are gone, then $399. Registration covers the reception, two lunches and the CE hours. Hotel rooms are booked separately through the group block, which closes April 19, 2027, and registrations cannot be refunded.
